Run it your way.

Every country on Earth — all 197, with real borders — is playable and targetable. Tap a suggested move or type anything ("cooperate with India for science and trade", "trade war with China") and your advisor executes it. Majors are easier; microstates are extreme hard mode.

📱 Play it like an app: in Safari tap Share → Add to Home Screen — it opens full-screen, no browser chrome, and your game saves right here on this device. Use Export (top bar) to copy a code and carry the same run into the Online Solo version, and Import to bring one back.

1 · Talk or tapTap the advisor's suggested moves, or type anything you want in plain English.
2 · Watch numbers moveEvery action changes Treasury, Economy, Military, Tech, Stability or Influence — no dead turns.
3 · End the monthThe world moves: AI deals, oil shocks, protests, wars. Reach #1 Influence by 2035.
